title: Russian Rice Pilaf
description: A classic Eastern European side dish made with rice, vegetables, and spices.

ingredients.name: quick
ingredients.notes: chopped mixed vegetables (e.g., carrots, peas, corn)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the rice and stir to combine with the vegetables and oil.
Add the dried parsley and dill, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
